name: Meatloaf
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Pat the 1/2 pounds chicken thighs dry with paper towels.
Rub all over with 1 tablespoon olive oil and season generously with 1 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon black pepper, 1/2 teaspoon dried rosemary.
Scatter the 1 cup carrots around the pan. Roast 75 minutes, until cooked through and the juices run clear.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing so the juices settle. Serve warm.
